overview: A landscaped podium links the homes with outdoor activity and community facilities. Apartment size and room arrangements vary materially: the three-bedroom Type A includes a maid room, while the compact Type A one-bedroom drawing uses a much smaller footprint.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha Central along Sheikh Zayed Road. Confirm the actual tower arrival, pedestrian route and unit orientation; marketing travel times and proposed road links are not fixed journey guarantees.
research.priceNote: The official page advertises AED 1.75m subject to inventory. Property Finder displays AED 2.5m for its selection and labels developer stock sold out. Different selections and dates do not establish a current available unit; request a written quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 20% down payment at launch, 40% during construction and 40% on handover. No dated current developer instalment sheet was found, so amounts, dates, fees and any transfer balance require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder lists December 2029, expressed as Q4 2029. This is a portal-reported estimate. Its promotional claims about future timely completion are not adopted as verified outcomes.
